label: Reel Caption Lane (timed kinetic phrases)
description: THE caption lane for vertical/square social cuts (9:16, 4:5): a timeline-driven stack of BIG kinetic phrases that fill their own box, one at a time, word-by-word. Unlike narration-track (a small lower-third pill over footage) this is the type FIELD itself -- give it the empty half of the frame under a camera card and it becomes the ad's headline track. Each phrase auto-fits its box, so a long line shrinks instead of overflowing. Wrap a word or run of words in *stars* to tint them with the brand's primary (re-mixed at runtime against the measured ground so the accent always clears 4.5:1).

phrases.label: Phrases
phrases.description: [{ text, start, end }] in scene-local seconds -- one entry per on-screen line. Drive start/end from the speaker transcript's word times so the type lands with the voice.

max_font.label: Starting font size in px before auto-fit (default 104)

min_font.label: Floor the auto-fit will not shrink past (default 44)
